breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a conflict between specifying 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and the much more detailed 'method: Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by correctly removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' line. The agent, however, failed to resolve the conflict and instead tried to merge the two contradictory instructions, stating 'Use explicit forward Euler time integration in the context of Strang operator splitting.' This is still incorrect and confusing, as the specified splitting method is not an explicit Euler method.
